stop_reason.description: The reason the model completion ended, as reported by the event source. Normalized to the caption of the stop_reason_id value (e.g. Token Limit); when the value is 'Other', this carries the event source's native label (e.g. recitation, malformed_function_call).
stop_reason.caption: Stop Reason

permission_result.description: The outcome of the agent runtime's permission check for this operation, as reported by the runtime. Normalized to the caption of the permission_result_id value; when the value is 'Other', this carries the runtime's native label.
permission_result.caption: Permission Result

0.description: The permission check outcome could not be determined, so the authorization state of the operation is not established.
0.caption: Unknown

1.description: The agent runtime's permission check permitted the operation to proceed.
1.caption: Allowed

2.description: The agent runtime's permission check refused the operation.
2.caption: Denied

99.description: The permission result is not mapped. See the permission_result attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
99.caption: Other

permission_result_id.description: The normalized outcome of the agent runtime's permission check for this operation, as reported by the runtime. Producers map their runtime's native value into this set; when the value is 'Other', set permission_result to the runtime's native label.
permission_result_id.caption: Permission Result ID

3.description: The completion paused to invoke a tool. The turn is not finished; the model expects the tool result and will continue.
3.caption: Tool Use

6.description: The completion ended because the sub-agent performing it was stopped - the parent agent terminated the child, the child's task was cancelled, or the sub-agent's budget or step limit was exhausted - rather than because the model reached a stopping point. Distinct from Session Stop, which is the session or transport carrying the completion terminating. Not for use on an event that itself records a sub-agent stopping; on such an event this attribute records why that sub-agent stopped.
6.caption: Sub-Agent Stop

0.description: The completion ended without the producer being able to determine why, so the state of the operation at termination is not established.
0.caption: Unknown

1.description: The model reached the end of its turn: it completed its response naturally or emitted a configured stop sequence, and is not waiting on anything further.
1.caption: End of Turn

2.description: The completion was truncated by a token or length limit before the model finished, so the response is incomplete.
2.caption: Token Limit

4.description: The completion ended because the session or connection carrying it terminated - for example the caller cancelled, the client disconnected, or the transport closed - rather than because the model reached a stopping point. The session state at termination is therefore known, which distinguishes this from Unknown and lets a consumer decide whether the operation needs investigation or can simply be reclaimed.
4.caption: Session Stop

99.description: The stop reason is not mapped. See the stop_reason attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
99.caption: Other

5.description: The completion was stopped by a safety, policy, or content moderation mechanism rather than by the model reaching a stopping point or by the caller. This includes a refusal raised by a safety classifier and a guardrail intervening on the request or the response.
5.caption: Content Filter

stop_reason_id.description: The normalized reason the model completion ended. Producers map their runtime's native value into this set. Populate on completion events; when the value is 'Other', set stop_reason to the event source's native label. Because completion behavior is bound to the configuration that produced it, a shift in this attribute's distribution is more meaningful when weighed against that configuration: ai_model.version for direct model invocations, and ai_agent.version, ai_agent.charter, and ai_agent.instance_uid for agent-mediated operations.
stop_reason_id.caption: Stop Reason ID

name: ai_status
description: Container for per-operation outcome scalars contributed by the ai_operation profile. Holds outcomes reported by the model or agent runtime, such as why a completion stopped or the result of a permission check, so they do not proliferate as discrete attributes at the event root. Additional outcome attributes may be added to this object in later versions.
caption: AI Status
